channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Lula desafia Flávio a abrir conta bancária 'para saber quem é ladrão'
item.description: In a presidential debate on Band, Lula challenged Flávio Bolsonaro to open family bank accounts and phone records to investigate alleged corruption acts. The challenge aimed to pressure the senator to disclose potential irregularities.

item.title: Em debate, Lula defende legado econômico, enquanto Flávio destaca custo de vida e dívidas
item.description: In the first runoff debate, Lula emphasized his economic legacy, while Flávio criticized rising prices and debt. Both addressed topics like economy and public policies.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro evita dizer se adotará modelo Milei no Brasil
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro avoided committing to adopting Milei-like policies during a presidential debate. Lula questioned possible alliance and Argentine economic model. PL candidate kept evasive stance.

item.title: Lula questiona sobre SUS; Flávio faz mea culpa sobre saúde no governo Jair Bolsonaro
item.description: In a Band/Estado debate, President Lula criticized Jair Bolsonaro's handling of the pandemic and questioned opponents' commitment to SUS. Flávio Bolsonaro responded with a mea-culpa regarding health policies during the previous administration, acknowledging failures in managing the health crisis.

item.title: Flávio cita custo de vida; Lula reage: 'Mais caro era no governo Bolsonaro'
item.description: In a Band debate, Lula rebutted Flávio Bolsonaro's criticism regarding inflation, claiming the cost of living was higher under Bolsonaro's government. Flávio emphasized the impact of inflation under the PT administration.

item.title: Flávio diz que R$ 134 mi de Vorcaro está no filme sobre o pai; Lula diz que prendeu banqueiro
item.description: In a Band/Estadão presidential debate, Lula and Flávio clashed: Lula labeled Flávio as irresponsible, claiming that the Bolsonaro government turned the former Banco Master banker into a fugitive and that his government arrested him. Flávio countered, alleging that R$134 million from Vorcaro is tied to a film project about his father, suggesting misuse of funds.

item.title: Lula diz que Flávio é 'malandro carioca'; Flávio diz se solidarizar com cariocas ofendidos
item.description: In a recent debate, President Lula called Flávio Bolsonaro a 'chronic liar' and 'scoundrel from Rio.' Flávio reacted sarcastically, claiming solidarity with Rio residents offended by the remarks. The exchange sparked backlash on social media.

item.title: Lula propõe a Flávio abrir sigilos bancário e telefônico de suas famílias
item.description: In a debate on Band, Lula challenged Flávio Bolsonaro to open banking and phone records of both candidates' families before the runoff, suggesting documents be reviewed by the Supreme Court and Electoral Court. The proposal came amid discussions on corruption and the Bolsonaro family's ties to the US.

item.title: Lula cobra Flávio por empregar familiares de acusado no caso Marielle
item.description: Lula questioned Flávio Bolsonaro over hiring relatives of Adriano da Nóbrega, linked to the Marielle Franco crime office. The race remains tied at 50%, per the latest poll.

item.title: Flávio conhece ônibus e trabalho por literatura, diz Lula
item.description: Lula claims Flávio Bolsonaro knows buses and workers only through literature, during Band debate. The PL candidate advocates for reducing work hours with public safety and increasing purchasing power.

item.title: Roberta Luchsinger reage e posta vídeo após ser chamada de ‘mentirosa’ por Lula em debate na Band
item.description: Roberta Luchsinger responded to Lula's accusations, denying being called a liar and stating she has evidence regarding ties between the government and her circle, including the president's son. She confirmed cooperating with authorities and expressed concerns over her safety and that of her daughters. The federal government denied any contact with her or with Fábio Lula.

item.title: Lula diz que eventual indulto a Bolsonaro pode beneficiar Vorcaro
item.description: In a presidential debate, Lula stated that a pardon for Jair Bolsonaro could benefit other convicts, such as Daniel Vorcaro, and defended temporary prison leaves for well-behaved inmates, excluding serious crimes. Flávio Bolsonaro criticized the stance, accusing the PT leader of favoring criminals over victims.

item.title: Flávio cobra Lula sobre “saidinhas”; petista defende benefício
item.description: In a presidential debate, Flávio Bolsonaro pressured Lula on 'saidinhas' and cited crimes committed by beneficiary inmates, while Lula defended the right of well-behaved prisoners, reaffirming the focus on resocialization.

item.title: Lula propõe abrir sigilos bancário e telefônico e desafia Flávio
item.description: In a Band debate, President Lula proposed opening the banking and phone records of Flávio Bolsonaro and his relatives to expose potential corruption. The proposal came amid mutual accusations between the politicians regarding irregularities involving family members and allies.

item.title: Lula diz que Eduardo Bolsonaro instiga "golpe contra o Brasil” nos EUA
item.description: Lula accused Eduardo Bolsonaro of instigating a coup against Brazil in the US, during a debate on Band TV. He claimed the Bolsonaro family is subordinated to American interests. Flávio Bolsonaro denied the accusations, calling them lies.

item.title: Debate: Flávio e Lula trocam ataques sobre CV, PCC e Escudo das Américas
item.description: In a debate on TV Band, Lula and Flávio traded accusations regarding public security, criticizing Brazil's relationship with the U.S. and the fight against organized crime. Lula questioned Flávio's activities in the United States and suggested he defends North American interests, while Flávio advocated for joining the Shield of the Americas and criticized Lula for preventing the PCC and CV from being classified as terrorist groups. The debate also touched on critical minerals, rare earths, and the use of the Armed Forces to reinforce borders.

item.title: A reclamação de ministro de Lula a Flávio no intervalo do debate da Band
item.description: During the Band debate, the Ministry of Communication, Sidônio Palmeira, criticized Flávio Bolsonaro's behavior after President Lula accused him of acting disrespectfully. Flávio walked behind Lula, made faces, and used dismissive gestures during the broadcast. Although the complaint was deemed unfounded since candidates may move freely around the studio, journalist Eduardo Oinegue asked them to avoid abrupt movements that could hinder viewer understanding.

item.title: Flávio cita áudio de Vorcaro sobre R$ 30 milhões ao Instituto Lula
item.description: In the Band debate, Flávio Bolsonaro questioned Lula about R$30 million allegedly transferred by Daniel Vorcaro to the Lula Institute, while demanding explanations for R$134 million intended for the film 'Dark Horse'. Lula denied any wrongdoing and labeled the claims as 'alarming' and 'irresponsible'. The debate marked the first direct confrontation between the candidates in the second round.

item.title: Lula cobra rastreamento de balas; Flávio questiona fronteiras
item.description: In a presidential debate, Lula demanded the removal of ammunition tagging and criticized the influx of illegal weapons, while Flávio denied supporting tracking and pointed to lack of border control. The candidates exchanged accusations about security and gun policies, with Lula recalling the loosening of access under Bolsonaro. The discussion involved Bill 3.723/2019, which proposes removing cartridge identification.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro e Lula trocam acusações de corrupção e envolvem familiares em debate
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro and Lula exchanged corruption accusations during their first runoff debate, involving family members and leaving the other without answers. The debate was marked by provocations and controversial approaches.

item.title: Flávio sobre vacinas na epidemia de Covid: "Tem Bolsonaro dentro do Lula"
item.description: In a televised debate, Flávio Bolsonaro acknowledged shortcomings in health management under his father's government but defended vaccine procurement, claiming 'There's Bolsonaro inside Lula' due to Lula receiving the immunizer. He also highlighted public security as a positive legacy of PT governments, citing over 770,000 homicides in two decades.

item.title: Flávio diz que Lula foi eleito por “aclamação nos presídios”
item.description: In a Band presidential debate, Senator Flávio Bolsonaro claimed President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva was elected by 'acclamation in prisons,' without providing evidence or data. Lula responded by defending the right of all Brazilians, including prisoners, to vote. The second round of elections is scheduled for October 25.

item.title: Flávio pede que Lula escreva “corrupto” durante debate
item.description: In a Band presidential debate, Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) provoked President Lula (PT) by suggesting he write the word 'corrupt' to link it to the PT acronym. Lula countered, accusing Flávio of making unsubstantiated claims, especially regarding R$134 million tied to businessman Daniel Vorcaro. Polls show a technical tie between the candidates ahead of the October 25 runoff.

item.title: Lula cobra Flávio por atuação em caso de criança morta por policial
item.description: In a presidential debate, Lula demanded explanations from Flávio Bolsonaro regarding his legal defense of a police officer accused of killing a 5-year-old girl; Flávio claimed he was just exercising legal representation.

item.title: Bolsonaristas hostilizam e perseguem casal apoiador de Lula na Avenida Paulista; assista
item.description: During the Bloquinho 22 event on Paulista Avenue, Lula supporters were targeted by Bolsonaro supporters, facing harassment and verbal abuse after displaying campaign stickers. Military police intervened to ensure safety and fend off attempts to obstruct press coverage.

item.title: Lula questiona proposta de Flávio para o SUS e discussão vira confusão
item.description: Lula questioned Flávio Bolsonaro's proposal to apply the SUS to the Albert Einstein hospital standard, leading to a heated debate on Band. The discussion became tense and required intervention from the mediator.

item.title: Flávio: "Lula defende mais os direitos dos bandidos que das vítimas"
item.description: In a presidential debate broadcast by TV Bandeirantes, Flávio Bolsonaro criticized Lula, claiming he prioritizes prisoners' rights over victims'. Lula countered that temporary prison leave for inmates with good behavior is an individual right, while emphasizing that those convicted of heinous crimes, rape, and violence against women should not be eligible.

item.title: Lula chama Flávio de "palhaço" e pergunta se ele quer privatizar o SUS
item.description: In a TV Band debate, Lula called Flávio 'clown' and questioned whether he intends to privatize SUS after a proposal involving Albert Einstein Hospital. Lula also criticized Bolsonaro's management during the pandemic, claiming 716,000 deaths were preventable.

item.title: Debate na ‘Band’: Lula lembra que Milei é inspiração para Flávio, mesmo com pobreza em alta na Argentina
item.description: In a debate on TV Band, Lula linked Flávio Bolsonaro to the ultra-libertarianism of Javier Milei, reminding viewers that he serves as an inspiration for the PL candidate. Flávio avoided answering questions about Milei's model, while Lula defended his own economic growth and social inclusion agenda. Poverty in Argentina, under Milei's government, reached 32.3% of the population, according to official data.

item.title: Flávio fala de gastos de Janja e Lula diz: “Mentiroso, malandro carioca”
item.description: In a heated debate on TV Band, Flávio Bolsonaro accused Lula of spending R$7 million on his wife Janja's trips. Lula fired back, calling him a 'liar' and 'carioca hustler'. The debate was marked by sharp exchanges over public spending cuts.

item.title: AO VIVO Debate da Band: Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro debatem pela primeira vez nas eleições 2026; acompanhe
item.description: Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro face off for the first time in the 2026 presidential runoff debate on TV Bandeirantes. The debate takes place a week before the election and marks the direct confrontation between the candidates after skipping forums in the first round.

item.title: Sistema do TSE aponta mudanças em locais de votação mesmo quando endereço permanece o mesmo
item.description: The TSE system has incorrectly recorded changes to voting locations, flagging address alterations that remain unchanged between the first and second rounds of the 2026 elections. Following criticism and data discrepancies identified by regional electoral courts, the number of supposedly modified sections dropped significantly during system updates.

item.title: “Quem deve explicações é você”: Lula é questionado sobre reunião com Vorcaro
item.description: In a Band debate, Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro discussed Lula's meeting with banker Daniel Vorcaro tied to R$134 million. Flávio demanded explanations from Lula over the encounter, sparking controversy.

item.title: Em debate na ‘Band’, Flávio Bolsonaro foge de perguntas sobre dinheiro de Vorcaro
item.description: In a debate on TV Band, Flávio Bolsonaro failed to explain the origin of $63 million transferred by Daniel Vorcaro to finance the film 'Dark Horse,' avoiding details about the funds' path to a US-based fund. When asked, the PL candidate only stated that the money was used to pay for the film, without clarifying ties to a lawyer allied with Eduardo Bolsonaro. During the debate, Flávio also attacked Lula, highlighting corruption convictions.

item.title: Lula diz que quer 100% dos votos de presidiários, incluindo Jair Bolsonaro
item.description: In a debate hosted by TV Band, President Lula jokingly stated he wants 100% of the votes from imprisoned people, including former president Jair Bolsonaro. His comment came after accusations by Senator Flávio Bolsonaro that Lula received support from inmates. The debate also touched on security and crime issues.

item.title: Lula pergunta sobre Dark Horse, e Flávio responde: “Vou te dar cortesia”
item.description: In a TV Band debate, Lula questioned Flávio Bolsonaro about R$134 million paid by Daniel Vorcaro for the film 'Dark Horse', demanding explanations about the funds' destination. Flávio claimed the money was used for film production and invited Lula to watch it, while Lula labeled his response as 'desfaçatez do miliciano'. The debate was marked by heated exchanges over controversies involving the campaign and figures close to both candidates.

item.title: Flávio não quer ser mais Bolsonaro
item.description: In a TV Band debate, Flávio Bolsonaro criticized Lula for linking him to his father Jair Bolsonaro, while Lula recalled the Covid-19 crisis and the economic management of the former president. The PT candidate used these points to discredit the PL candidate.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro é alvo de 2º inquérito no STF por suspeita de lavagem
item.description: The Federal Police forwarded a second inquiry to the STF investigating Senator Flávio Bolsonaro on money laundering suspicions related to lawyer Willer Tomaz and the company Alcazar Holding. The investigation examines suspicious financial transactions, contacts between the two, and potential irregularities.

item.title: Debate da Band vira ‘casos de família’ entre Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: The first segment of the Band TV debate between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro focused on family-related issues, including a bill vote in the Rio de Janeiro Legislative Assembly. The exchange, lasting about ten minutes, marked the start of electoral discussions.

item.title: Flávio encurrala Lula com perguntas sobre Roberta e Lulinha
item.description: In a Band debate, Flávio Bolsonaro pressed Lula on investigations involving Roberta Luchsinger and Fábio Luís Lula da Silva, accusing him of protecting family members. The PL candidate used the opportunity to question alleged irregularities while seeking momentum in the 2026 presidential race.

item.title: Caetano Veloso y decenas de artistas se vuelcan con Lula en un acto masivo en la playa de Copacabana
item.description: Caetano Veloso and dozens of artists attended a massive rally on Copacabana Beach in support of President Lula, one of the final events before the 2026 election deciding between the incumbent and far-right leader Flávio Bolsonaro, son of Jair Bolsonaro.

item.title: Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro fazem o primeiro debate do 2º turno
item.description: Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro faced off in the first presidential debate of the runoff, focusing mainly on public security. Flávio proposed a 'war on narcoterrorism' against criminal factions, while Lula advocated for greater federal cooperation with states on security matters.

item.title: Eleitores do Paraná decidem em plebiscito inédito se comunidade mudará de cidade
item.description: Paraná will hold Brazil's first-ever plebiscite to determine whether a community's territory should be transferred between two municipalities during the second round of elections, giving voters a direct say on regional territorial reorganization.

item.title: Míssil inflável 'explode' no colo de Flávio
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro faces criticism following an incident involving an inflatable missile during a political event. The text also mentions pro-Lula protests on Avenida Paulista and allegations of vandalism against a subway station. The scenario highlights tensions between supporters of different political spectrums in the 2026 elections.

item.title: Apoiadores de Lula vão às ruas no Rio, Brasília, Salvador e BH na reta final do segundo turno
item.description: Supporters of President Luiz Inácio Lula Silva (PT) held protests in four major Brazilian capitals — Rio de Janeiro, Salvador, Brasília, and Belo Horizonte — on Sunday, April 18, rallying behind his re-election campaign in the final week before the second round of elections.

item.title: Adesivaço pró-Flávio Bolsonaro reúne apoiadores na Praça Rui Barbosa, em Apucarana
item.description: A sticker campaign in support of Senator Flávio Bolsonaro gathered hundreds of supporters at Praça Rui Barbosa in Apucarana. The PL member is a pre-candidate for the Presidency of the Republic in the 2026 elections.

item.title: Manifestantes denunciam agressões de bolsonaristas em dia de atos em SP
item.description: Protesters reported attacks by Bolsonaro supporters against Lula followers during demonstrations at train stations in São Paulo. Videos circulating on social media show clashes at two metro stations, raising concerns about the safety of political gatherings. The allegations highlight growing tension between groups ahead of the 2026 elections.

item.title: Messias posta mensagem de ‘Exército do Lula’ convocando para atos no Rio de Janeiro
item.description: Attorney General Jorge Messias shared a call from 'Lula's Army', a WhatsApp group coordinated by Congressman André Janones, urging supporters to attend rallies in Rio de Janeiro this Sunday.

item.title: Janones posta foto sua em debate: “General chegou”
item.description: Federal deputy André Janones (Rede-MG) attended President Lula's debate on Band and skipped a Rio rally to support reelection. He leads the PT's digital campaign through the 'Exército do Lula' WhatsApp channel with over 5 million followers.

item.title: Lula x Flávio: veja quando saem as novas pesquisas Datafolha, Quaest e mais
item.description: This week, before the 2026 presidential runoff, several polling firms will release new surveys, including Datafolha, Quaest, Real Time Big Data, and AtlasIntel. These polls measure the race between President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) and Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), with interviews conducted between October 15 and 24.
